task_description: Write a method in Dafny to check if the given array represents min heap or not.
specification_response:
method IsMinHeap(a: array<int>) returns (isHeap: bool)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - If the method returns true, then the array satisfies the min-heap property: for every index i, a[i] is less than or equal to its children (if any)
- If the method returns false, then there exists at least one parent node in the array that is greater than its child(ren)
